prose: The Financial Times reports, citing Radical Ventures, that AI 'neolabs' - many lacking products, markets or revenue - raised $24B in the past two quarters, nearly five times what OpenAI and Anthropic raised at comparable pre-product stages. The article is paywalled, so this summary is based on the headline and lead captured by the feed.
highlights: AI neolabs raised $24B in two quarters, per Radical Ventures via FT
Many have no product, market or revenue
Nearly 5x the comparable early raises of OpenAI and Anthropic
Paywalled - summary based on headline and lead
